title: QA Generation Chain
summary: This module provides a chain for generating question-answer pairs from input text documents. It processes text by splitting it into chunks, using an LLM to generate Q&A for each chunk, and then aggregating the results. Note: This class is deprecated in favor of a Runnable-based approach.

nodes.label: Input Document Text
nodes.title: Input Document
nodes.description: The raw text document provided to the chain, which will be processed to generate question-answer pairs.

nodes.label: Split Document into Chunks
nodes.title: Text Splitter
nodes.description: Breaks down the large input document into smaller, manageable text segments or chunks, suitable for individual processing by the language model.

nodes.label: Orchestrate QA Generation
nodes.title: QAGenerationChain
nodes.description: The main chain component that coordinates the text splitting, invokes the LLM chain for each chunk, and collects the generated question-answer pairs.

nodes.label: Generate QA for Chunk
nodes.title: LLMChain
nodes.description: A sub-chain responsible for taking a single text chunk and, using a language model and prompt, generating question-answer pairs from its content.

nodes.label: Large Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: Language Model
nodes.description: The AI model that performs the core natural language understanding and generation, producing raw text responses based on the prompt and context.

nodes.label: QA Generation Prompt
nodes.title: Prompt Template
nodes.description: A predefined template that structures the input to the LLM, guiding it to generate question-answer pairs in a specific format.

nodes.label: Parse LLM Output (JSON)
nodes.title: JSON Parser
nodes.description: Interprets the raw text output from the language model, extracting structured JSON data containing the generated question-answer pairs.

nodes.label: Output QA Pairs
nodes.title: Generated QA
nodes.description: The final collection of structured question-answer pairs, aggregated from all processed text chunks.

groups.label: QA Generation Chain
groups.title: Core QA Generation Logic
groups.description: The primary component responsible for orchestrating the entire process of generating question-answer pairs from a given document.

groups.label: Data Input/Output
groups.title: Data Handling
groups.description: Represents the entry point for raw data and the final output of processed question-answer pairs.

groups.label: Text Preparation & Parsing
groups.title: Document Processing
groups.description: Components involved in preparing the input text for the LLM and structuring its raw output.

groups.label: LLM Interaction
groups.title: Generative Core
groups.description: The components directly involved in leveraging the Large Language Model for generating responses.
